<?xml version="1.0"?>
<package format="3">
  <name>d435_cpp</name>
  <version>0.1.0</version>
  <description>C++ D435 publisher — Python rclpy publish (~133ms/frame) 의 360x 빠름. ROS2 + ZMQ + 시간 동기화 통합.</description>
  <maintainer email="minji.kwon@genon.ai">minji</maintainer>
  <license>Apache-2.0</license>

  <buildtool_depend>ament_cmake</buildtool_depend>

  <depend>rclcpp</depend>
  <depend>sensor_msgs</depend>
  <depend>geometry_msgs</depend>
  <depend>tf2_ros</depend>
  <depend>builtin_interfaces</depend>
  <depend>librealsense2</depend>
  <depend>libzmq3-dev</depend>
  <depend>libmsgpack-dev</depend>
  <depend>libopencv-dev</depend>

  <export>
    <build_type>ament_cmake</build_type>
  </export>
</package>
